# Model Zero

> Model Zero (MZ) is a Cairo-based software and AI company. It builds custom systems and trains teams to run them, informed by applied research.

## Primary pages

- [Model Zero home](https://www.mzfortech.com/): Studio overview.
- [Work](https://www.mzfortech.com/work): Selected software projects and products.
- [Services](https://www.mzfortech.com/services): Software engineering, deployment, and knowledge transfer.
- [About Model Zero](https://www.mzfortech.com/about): Studio approach and background.
- [Contact](https://www.mzfortech.com/contact): Project inquiries.
- [The Null Hypothesis research portal](https://www.mzfortech.com/research): MZ's published research.
- [Research in Arabic](https://www.mzfortech.com/research/ar): Arabic edition of the research portal.
- [Plain-text site summary](https://www.mzfortech.com/content.md): Machine-readable overview of the studio and selected work.
- [XML sitemap](https://www.mzfortech.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical pages available for crawling.

## What MZ does

MZ builds custom software and AI systems, helps deploy them, and trains client teams to operate them. Applied research informs its products and client work.

MZ is based in Cairo, Egypt. Contact: [hello@mzfortech.com](mailto:hello@mzfortech.com).

## Research

- **The Null Hypothesis** is MZ's research publication. It currently publishes four essays, with interactive explanations and selected Arabic editions.

### Published essays

- [DarkVeil: There's a Neural Network Running Behind This Page](https://www.mzfortech.com/research/essays/darkveil-neural-network): how a frozen neural network shader maps coordinates to an animated image.
- [The Measure and the Target](https://www.mzfortech.com/research/essays/the-measure-and-the-target): Goodhart's law, statistical measures, AI reward models, and benchmark optimization. [Arabic edition](https://www.mzfortech.com/research/ar/essays/the-measure-and-the-target).
- [A Deep Reading of SVD](https://www.mzfortech.com/research/essays/a-deep-reading-of-svd): an interactive explanation of singular value decomposition, geometry, low-rank approximation, and PCA. [Arabic edition](https://www.mzfortech.com/research/ar/essays/a-deep-reading-of-svd).
- [A Deep Reading of L₀](https://www.mzfortech.com/research/essays/a-deep-reading-of-l0): an interactive explanation of L₀ regularization, stochastic gates, and structured neural network pruning. [Arabic edition](https://www.mzfortech.com/research/ar/essays/a-deep-reading-of-l0).

## Selected work

- [Nested United case study](https://www.mzfortech.com/work/nested-united): MZ's work on a digital platform for Nested United.
